mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM quote q WHERE q.id = #{quoteId} AND q.deleted = 0 AND q.status = 1 )

SELECT c.id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, COUNT(q.id) AS quoteCount FROM quote q INNER JOIN category c ON q.category_id = c.id WHERE AND c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') GROUP BY q.category_id, c.id, c.name ORDER BY quoteCount DESC LIMIT 3
